{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99 (without commas)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Show the first few QA order rows
qa_orders.head()"}
